english.title: Refuse / neglect to answer question / furnish information / produce document when required - Child Support Act 1991
english.standardoffencewording:

(A)_[to answer a question]_
(B)_[to furnish information, namely **(..SPECIFY THE INFORMATION..),]_

english.legislation: Contrary to section 15(9)(b) of the Child Support Act 1991.
